payload.core_composition_summary: Sort differences, then DSU merges components in non-decreasing gap order, maintaining max subarray sum to compute profit = mx - gap^2.
payload.rationale: Two distinct mechanisms: sorting determines edge processing order; DSU with augmented fields performs efficient merging and max subarray computation. No DP; it's data structure augmentation.
